newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca shares gain amid fresh bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca shares gain amid fresh bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc romped higher at the start of trading on Thursday amid fresh rumours of a merger or takeover by a continental European drug group, traders said.
Zeneca shares were up 24p at 15.67-1/2 stg by 0753 GMT, near their intraday record of 15.91 stg set on September 9.
Volume in the stock was a modest 357,220 shares.

Traders said today's market talk centred on speculation of a link with Germany's Bayer AG, but also pointed out that rumours in recent months of a bid or merger involving Zeneca had so far proved inaccurate.

"Bid talk resurfaced early on, with active trading in the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs)," said one senior sales trader, "there is believed to be Swiss buying, with Bayer mentioned as one possible predator."
Zeneca ADRs quoted in London were up 40 cents at $73.50 in volume of 40,000.
"Zeneca keeps blowing hot and cold but one day maybe we'll come in and there'll be a bid," the sales trader said.
A spokeswoman for Zeneca said the company had a policy to never comment on market rumour.
